description: This C# source file defines extension methods for working with lifecycle observers in the Orleans framework. It provides methods to subscribe observers to lifecycle events, handling start and stop actions with support for diagnostics.

classes.name: LifecycleExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ILifecycleObservable to subscribe to lifecycle events with optional start and stop handlers.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Creates a disposable subscription to the lifecycle, with overloads to specify start/stop delegates or observers.

methods.name: Subscribe<TObserver>
methods.description: Overloads of Subscribe that accept observer type or start/stop delegates, and create corresponding subscriptions.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Private inner class implementing ILifecycleObserver to invoke supplied start and stop functions.

classes.name: StartupObserver
classes.description: Private sealed class implementing ILifecycleObserver that disposes itself after start is invoked, used for startup-only subscriptions.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Extension method that creates a subscription to an ILifecycleObservable with specified observer name, stage, and start/stop delegates.

methods.name: Subscribe<TObserver>
methods.description: Extension method that creates a subscription to an ILifecycleObservable with observer type name as diagnostic, and start/stop delegates.
